questions.passage: In a suburb in the Pacific Northwest, Justin ties his shoes for his morning run and steps out at dawn. As he walks off his front step, he spots some racoons <u>ⓐ crossing</u> the street. Birds begin to sing, and he enjoys the beauty of his neighborhood. While running, a dangerous sight <u>ⓑ interrupts</u> the idyllic scene. A coyote watches as a black bear <u>ⓒ searches</u> through a garbage bin for food. Justin is surprised at his neighborhood <u>ⓓ transforming</u> into a place full of wildlife encounters. In 2019, it was estimated that more than 1.5 million squirrels <u>ⓔ were living</u> in Chicago.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 어법상 어색한 것은?

det.ref: [원문] While running, a dangerous sight interrupts the idyllic scene. [해석] 달리는 도중, 위험한 광경이 목가적인 장면을 방해한다. While (he was) running에서 분사구문의 의미상 주어는 Justin(he)인데, 주절 주어가 a dangerous sight이므로 분사구문 주어 불일치(dangling modifier)가 발생합니다.
det.correct:
ⓐ crossing: 지각동사 spots + O(racoons) + v-ing(현재분사) → 너구리들이 길을 건너는 동작을 진행 중인 것을 목격 ✅
ⓑ interrupts: While running(=While he was running)의 의미상 주어는 he(Justin)인데 주절 주어가 a dangerous sight → dangling modifier(수식어 매달림) ❌
ⓒ searches: 주어 a black bear(3인칭 단수) + 현재시제 -es → 주어-동사 수일치 정확 ✅
ⓓ transforming: be surprised at + 동명사(v-ing) → 전치사 at의 목적어로 동명사 사용 ✅
ⓔ were living: 주어 squirrels(복수) + 과거진행 were living → it was estimated that절 내 시제/수 일치 정확 ✅
det.tip: 🔑 분사구문의 의미상 주어 일치: 분사구문의 생략된 주어 = 주절 주어여야 함. While running, he saw... (○) / While running, a sight interrupted... (✕ → dangling modifier). 지각동사(see, spot, watch) + O + v-ing: 진행 중인 동작 목격. be surprised at + v-ing: 전치사 뒤 동명사.

questions.passage: Scientists questioned such a destructive control method, as coyotes are highly adaptive and breed quickly. A study showed that a simulated coyote population survived indefinitely when 70% (A) <u>were killed / was killed</u> annually. In coyote packs, a dominant adult pair maintains a strict structure that (B) <u>prevents / preventing</u> others from breeding and controls the population. Destructive control methods often disrupt this social structure, (C) <u>resulting / resulted</u> in increased populations.
questions.stem: (A), (B), (C)에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.ref: [원문] A study showed that a simulated coyote population survived indefinitely when 70% were killed annually. [해석] 한 연구는 매년 70%가 죽었을 때 모의 코요테 개체 수가 무한히 생존한다는 것을 보여주었다. (A) 70%는 복수 개체 → were killed (B) 관계대명사 that절의 동사 → prevents (C) 결과 분사구문 → resulting
det.correct:
(A) were killed vs was killed: 70%(of a population)는 복수 개체를 지칭 → 복수 동사 were killed ✅ / was killed ❌
(B) prevents vs preventing: 관계대명사 that절의 동사. maintains ... that prevents ... and controls로 세 동사가 병렬(maintains, prevents, controls) → prevents ✅ / preventing ❌
(C) resulting vs resulted: 앞절의 결과를 나타내는 분사구문 → resulting ✅ / resulted ❌ (접속사 없이 과거형 불가)
det.tip: 🔑 백분율 주어 수일치: 70% of + 복수명사 → 복수동사. 관계대명사 that절 내 동사: 선행사에 수일치 + 병렬구조 확인. 결과 분사구문: , resulting in ~ (= and it results in ~).

was killed — prevents — resulting
were killed — preventing — resulted

questions.passage: Living near the park, a thirteen-year-old boy named Richard Turere was responsible for <u>ⓐ keeping</u> his family's cattle safe from lions that often came out of the park at night to hunt. While <u>ⓑ rounding</u> up his cattle one night, Richard discovered that lions were scared of moving lights and didn't come near the cattle enclosure when he walked around <u>ⓒ carried</u> a flashlight. Soon, he fastened flashing LED bulbs onto poles around the enclosure <u>ⓓ facing</u> the outside.
questions.stem: 위 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓓ 중, 어법상 어색한 것은?

det.ref: [원문] didn't come near the cattle enclosure when he walked around carrying a flashlight. [해석] 손전등을 들고 돌아다닐 때 사자들이 소 울타리 근처에 오지 않았다. walked around carrying은 동시동작 분사구문. carried(과거형)는 접속사 없이 동사 나열 → 문법 오류.
det.correct:
ⓐ keeping: be responsible for + 동명사(v-ing) → 전치사 for의 목적어. keep + O + C(형용사 safe) ✅
ⓑ rounding: While rounding up = While he was rounding up → 분사구문 주어(Richard)와 주절 주어 일치 ✅
ⓒ carried: walked around carrying이 원문. 동시동작 분사구문(~하면서). carried(과거형)는 접속사(and) 없이 동사 두 개 나열 → ❌ → carrying ✅
ⓓ facing: poles around the enclosure facing the outside → 현재분사가 poles를 뒤에서 수식 ✅
det.tip: 🔑 동시동작 분사구문: 주절 동사 + v-ing. He walked around carrying a flashlight. 비교: He sat reading a book. 후치수식 현재분사: 명사 + v-ing → poles facing the outside = poles which face the outside.

questions.passage: One reason is that many cities are built on biologically (A) <u>fertile / barren</u> and productive land areas, which are attractive not only to humans but to other creatures as well. Another reason is due to urban areas becoming greener, (B) <u>inviting / repelling</u> more wild animals. det.ref: [원문] many cities are built on biologically fertile and productive land areas [해석] 많은 도시가 생물학적으로 비옥하고 생산적인 토지 위에 건설되어 있다. 도시에 야생동물이 많은 이유를 설명하는 문맥이므로 긍정적 의미의 단어가 적절합니다.

(A) fertile(비옥한) vs barren(불모의): 도시에 동물이 많은 이유 → 비옥한 토지 → fertile ✅ / barren ❌
(B) inviting(유인하는) vs repelling(쫓아내는): 녹지 증가 → 야생동물 유인 → inviting ✅ / repelling ❌
(C) attracting(끌어당기는) vs discouraging(단념시키는): 공원이 야생 생물 유인 → attracting ✅ / discouraging ❌
det.tip: 🔑 fertile(비옥한) ≈ productive, rich ↔ barren(불모의). invite(유인하다) ≈ attract, lure ↔ repel(쫓아내다). attract ≈ draw ↔ discourage(단념시키다). 문맥: 동물 증가 이유 → 긍정적 흐름.

questions.passage: People were outraged and immediately took action to remove the species from their neighborhoods. They killed a total of 55 coyotes over a period of 80 days. Scientists, however, questioned such a destructive control method, as coyotes are highly ① <u>adaptive</u> and breed quickly. A study showed that a simulated coyote population survived ② <u>indefinitely</u> when 70% were killed annually. This means that killing even most of the coyotes in a population will have no ③ <u>significant</u> effect. In coyote packs, a dominant adult pair maintains a strict structure that prevents others from breeding and ④ <u>expands</u> the population. Destructive control methods often ⑤ <u>disrupt</u> this social structure, resulting in increased populations.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 ①~⑤ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.ref: [원문] a dominant adult pair maintains a strict structure that prevents others from breeding and controls the population. [해석] 우세한 성체 쌍이 다른 코요테 번식을 막고 개체 수를 통제하는 구조 유지. 원문 controls → expands로 변경. 번식을 막는 구조가 개체 수를 확장하는 것은 논리 모순.
det.correct:
① adaptive(적응력 있는): 코요테의 높은 적응력 → 적절 ✅
② indefinitely(무한히): 70% 죽여도 무한 생존 → 적절 ✅
③ significant(상당한): no significant effect → 적절 ✅
④ expands(확장하다): 원문은 controls(통제하다). 번식 억제 구조가 개체 수를 '확장'? → 정반대 의미 ❌
⑤ disrupt(붕괴시키다): 파괴적 방법이 사회 구조 붕괴 → 적절 ✅
det.tip: 🔑 controls(통제하다) ≈ regulates ↔ expands(확장하다). adaptive ≈ adaptable, flexible. disrupt ≈ destabilize ↔ maintain. 풀이: 코요테 사회 구조 = 번식 억제 + 개체 수 통제 → expands는 모순.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 "temporary tenants of this precious planet"이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.ref: [원문] temporary tenants of this precious planet [해석] 이 소중한 행성의 일시적인 거주자. temporary(일시적) = 영원한 소유자 아님. tenant(세입자) = 빌려 사는 존재. 지구는 누구의 소유물이 아니라 함께 빌려 쓰는 곳.
det.correct:
① 영원히 함께 → temporary(일시적)와 모순 ❌
② 지구를 잠시 빌려 쓰는 동등한 존재 → temporary + tenants + Neither is less valuable 반영 ✅
③ 인간만 관리 책임 → both로 둘 다 동등 ❌
④ 동물은 약한 존재 → Neither is less valuable ❌
⑤ 서로 경쟁 → 조화(harmony)가 핵심 ❌
det.tip: 🔑 temporary ≈ transient, fleeting ↔ permanent. tenant(세입자) ≈ occupant ↔ owner(소유자). 함축: 소유자가 아닌 세입자 → 동등한 위치, 겸손한 태도.

questions.passage:
[주어진 글] Living near the park, a thirteen-year-old boy named Richard Turere was responsible for keeping his family's cattle safe from lions.

(A) Soon, he fastened flashing LED bulbs onto poles around the enclosure facing the outside and connected them to an old car battery powered by a solar panel.
(B) While rounding up his cattle one night, Richard discovered that lions were scared of moving lights and didn't come near the cattle enclosure when he walked around carrying a flashlight.
(C) He devised the lights to flicker on and off from time to time. It worked perfectly. After he installed his first "lion lights," he never spotted lions again.
questions.stem: 주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.ref: [해석] 주어진 글: Richard는 사자로부터 소를 보호하는 책임. → (B) 어느 날 밤 사자가 불빛을 무서워함을 발견. → (A) 곧 LED 전구를 기둥에 설치, 태양 전지판 배터리 연결. → (C) 깜빡이도록 고안, 완벽 작동, 다시는 사자를 보지 못함.
det.correct:
(B) 먼저: 주어진 글(사자 문제) → (B)에서 discovered(발견)로 실마리.
(A) 다음: Soon(곧)으로 발견 직후 LED 설치.
(C) 마지막: devised(고안) + 결과(It worked perfectly).
따라서 (B)-(A)-(C) ✅
det.tip: 🔑 순서 배열: 시간 단서(one night → Soon → after). 논리 흐름: 문제 인식 → 발견 → 설치 → 결과. discovered → fastened → devised → worked.
